name: hero-portraits
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production cozy RPG PIXEL ART PORTRAIT expression row, exactly THREE equal SQUARE cells side by side, 3:1 canvas, one row only. Adapt the attached hero identity into the attached Dax portrait row's chunky pixel art style. Image 1 hero idle sprite identity and colors; image 2 hero concept crop identity; image 3 Dax portrait row STYLE ONLY. HERO is sixteen, very fair freckled skin, straight strawberry-blond wedge haircut with long diagonal fringe covering HIS RIGHT eye (viewer LEFT), one visible eye on viewer right. No curls. Navy canvas jacket with cream collar and cuffs, brass key on cord, brown diagonal satchel strap. Identical hair outline and costume across all three portraits, front-facing viewer, head and shoulders with top of chest and key visible. Left cell calm neutral closed mouth; middle glad warm smile; right troubled worried brow and mouth. Keep head size and alignment identical across expressions. Dark tinted brown closed 1-2 pixel outline, warm upper-left light, flat limited warm palette and crisp chunky pixel clusters at intended final 128x128 per cell, no gradients or smooth painting. Palette brown #302529 #493335 #65453a, hair #c48d64 #e4af7b #f7d3a1, fair cream #fff0cf with rose shadows, jacket #263441 #35506b, cream #eae6cd, brass #d4aa58. Genuine transparent background, generous transparent margin in each cell, all hair and shoulders fit fully, no text, no grids, no cast shadows, no ground. Do not copy Dax's spiky crewcut, two visible eyes or square face. Identity costume colours and silhouette from hero references; pixel style outline light from portrait reference. No orange cloak, no teal.
review: Calm, glad and troubled retain the straight strawberry-blond fringe covering his right eye, fair freckles, navy jacket, cream collar, brass key and brown strap. Same hair silhouette across expressions. Kept attempt 1.
